White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia's Legal Credentials Under Scrutiny

White House press secretary Katie Zacharia is facing scrutiny over her legal career and credentials. A group has stated that Zacharia may have violated California law by referring to herself as an attorney. Zacharia has responded by saying she practiced international transaction law with all appropriate credentials.
